title: [Fecal microbiota transplantation inhibits colonic tumor growth in mice by suppressing the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway].
authors: Zhang, Junqi; Bai, Jing; Ren, Xing; Ye, Xueshuai; Tan, Mengtian; Yang, Yong; Li, Lei; Fu, Zexian
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究粪菌移植通过TLR4/NF-kB通路抑制结肠癌，含LPS-TLR4分子对接和NF-kB启动子结合预测，但核心是肿瘤免疫而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法仅简单对接与数据库预测，深度不足。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To explore the effects of fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) on immune function and tumor inhibition in mice. METHODS: C57BL/6N mice were divided into blank control group, tumor bearing model group, and FMT intervention group (n=6). In the latter two groups, the mice bearing subcutaneous MC38 colon cancer cell xenografts were treated with daily gavage of normal saline or 0.1 mL of bacterial suspension. The changes in tumor mass and volume were recorded, and peripheral blood natural killer (NK) cell counts and NKG2A and NKG2D receptor expressions were analyzed using flow cytometry; serum lipopolysaccharide (LPS) levels were measured with ELISA. The binding ability of NF‑kappaB to the TGF‑beta1 gene promoter was analyzed with JASPAR. The mRNA and protein expressions of TLR4, MyD88, NF‑kappaB, TGF‑beta1, perforin and granzyme in the tumor tissues were detected using RT qPCR and Western blotting, and the changes in gut microbiota were analyzed using 16S high throughput sequencing. RESULTS: FMT significantly reduced tumor mass and volume in the tumor-bearing mice. Peripheral CD3(-)NK1.1(+) cell counts were significantly decreased in the tumor-bearing mice regardless of FMT treatment, which, however, reversed the increase of CD3(-)NKG2A(+) cells and reduction of CD3(-)NKG2D(+) cells and reduced serum LPS levels in the mouse models. Molecular docking and JASPAR analysis confirmed LPS-TLR4 binding (binding energy: -13.1 kcal/mol) and identified NF-kappaB binding sites on TGF‑beta1 promoter. FMT downregulated mRNA and protein expressions of TLR4, MyD88, NF‑kappaB and TGF‑beta1 and upregulated perforin and granzyme mRNA expressions in the xenografts. FMT also restored gut microbiota diversity and composition, and reversed the increase of Proteobacteria and decrease of Lactobacillus murinus in the tumor-bearing mice. CONCLUSIONS: FMT modulates the relative abundances of intestinal Proteobacteria and Lactobacillus murinus in tumor-bearing mice, and inhibits tumor growth by suppressing the TLR4/MyD88/NF‑kappaB signaling axis, down-regulating TGF-beta1 expression, and promoting NK cell activation.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨粪菌移植（fecal microbiota transplantation, FMT）对小鼠免疫功能及肿瘤抑制作用的影响。方法：将C57BL/6N小鼠分为空白对照组、荷瘤模型组和FMT干预组（n=6）。后两组小鼠皮下接种MC38结肠癌细胞异种移植瘤，分别每日灌胃生理盐水或0.1 mL菌液。记录肿瘤质量和体积变化，采用流式细胞术分析外周血自然杀伤（NK）细胞计数及NKG2A和NKG2D受体表达；ELISA法检测血清脂多糖（LPS）水平。利用JASPAR分析NF-kappaB与TGF-beta1基因启动子的结合能力。采用RT qPCR和Western blotting检测肿瘤组织中TLR4、MyD88、NF-kappaB、TGF-beta1、穿孔素和颗粒酶的mRNA及蛋白表达，并利用16S高通量测序分析肠道菌群变化。结果：FMT显著降低荷瘤小鼠的肿瘤质量和体积。外周CD3(-)NK1.1(+)细胞计数在荷瘤小鼠中显著减少，无论是否接受FMT治疗；但FMT逆转了CD3(-)NKG2A(+)细胞增加和CD3(-)NKG2D(+)细胞减少，并降低了模型小鼠血清LPS水平。分子对接和JASPAR分析确认了LPS-TLR4结合（结合能：-13.1 kcal/mol），并识别了TGF-beta1启动子上的NF-kappaB结合位点。FMT下调异种移植瘤中TLR4、MyD88、NF-kappaB和TGF-beta1的mRNA及蛋白表达，并上调穿孔素和颗粒酶的mRNA表达。FMT还恢复了肠道菌群多样性和组成，逆转了荷瘤小鼠中变形菌门增加和鼠乳杆菌减少的现象。结论：FMT调节荷瘤小鼠肠道变形菌门和鼠乳杆菌的相对丰度，并通过抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号轴、下调TGF-beta1表达及促进NK细胞活化来抑制肿瘤生长。
